content:
Whiskers passed 5 days ago and it often feels like he passed this morning.

I traded in the morning through around 1 pm, but like the rest of the week it h as been choppy

We got up early about 6:40 and walked to City Hall later in the morning whih felt really good.

We also went to La Tierra and in the afternoon trader joe's to get groceries.

It was actually really good to get get out.

In the afternoon I worked on refining the "Bitcoin Memorial" / Continuum Memorial -- Liz actually became my first customer (sent me $21 for doing a memorial for mom -- Daphne Chunt
(started around 5:00 but didn't finalize until 8:00 or so but I think I can streamline it quite a bit)

Brainstormed a lot in the evening with Dr. C about how this could be expanded (potentially) for any milestone (not just a death) -- births, weddings, etc..
